title: Semantic Versioning (SemVer)
summary: Semantic Versioning (SemVer) is a versioning scheme: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. MAJOR: incompatible API changes. MINOR: backward-compatible functionality. PATCH: backward-compatible bug fixes. Pre-release: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH-rc.1. Build metadata: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH+build.123.

notes: MAJOR: incremented for incompatible API changes.
MINOR: incremented for backward-compatible new functionality.
PATCH: incremented for backward-compatible bug fixes.
Pre-release: hyphen + dot-separated identifiers (rc.1, alpha, beta.2).
Pre-release has lower precedence than normal version.
